name: Jellyfin Color Tags
overview: Add colors and names, then drag to reorder. The dot appears above the more button on posters and next to the favorite button in the player. A color can also cap the streaming bitrate or always transcode. English by default; Simplified Chinese for any zh display language, including zh-CN, zh-TW, and zh-HK.
description: Mark items with a colored dot on posters and in the web player.

versions.changelog: Keeps the player color dot, and stops poster dots from covering Playback Info. On the video page those poster buttons are removed. The Playback Info panel sits above any that remain, so its close button receives the click.
